subject: Post-call: lock evaluation window & prompt benchmarking plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@medsprint.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + options to lock evaluation window

Hi Maya — thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the evaluation moving.

Recap (high level)
- Primary objective: validate Redwood for summarization + QA assistant across Medsprint support transcripts (goal: 60–70% reduction in triage time; accuracy bar >= 92% on our prompt set).
- Success metrics you emphasized: latency under 400ms median for short queries, and no PII retention beyond test window.
- Technical constraints: customer-owned S3 for log access; SOC 2 evidence required for Dedicated options.

Proposed next meeting: Evaluation kickoff (45–60m) — agenda:
1) Confirm trial scope and success criteria (10m)
2) Tech deep-dive: data flow, model variant choices, privacy controls (20m)
3) Prompt benchmark plan and sample prompts (10m)
4) Next steps & mutual action items (5–10m)

I have the following windows available next week (Pacific):
- Tue 14 Dec: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 15 Dec: 09:00–10:00 or 15:30–16:30
- Thu 16 Dec: 11:00–12:00

Would any of these work? If not, send 2–3 times that do and I’ll lock with calendar invites. I attached a short mutual action plan draft (mpa_draft.pdf) that maps owners and deliverables — we can iterate during the kickoff.

Attendees we recommend: your engineering lead + product owner; I’ll bring Soojin (solutions engineer) and Marissa (customer success).

Notes on the prompt benchmarking pack: I attached a sample CSV (prompt-bench-sample.csv) with 12 starter prompts and expected output checks — if you can flag 6–8 internal test cases that matter most, we’ll prioritize those for the trial evaluation.

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

Attachment: mpa_draft.pdf (Proposed mutual action plan — owners/dates)
Attachment: prompt-bench-sample.csv (sample prompt set for benchmarking)
From: Maya Singh <maya@medsprint.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya@medsprint.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + options to lock evaluation window

Jordan — thanks for the summary and for sending the materials. Tue 14 Dec at 10:00 PT works for our team; I’ll add Priya (eng lead) and Arjun (security). A couple quick questions before the kickoff:

1) Model variants: we want to understand tradeoffs between accuracy and cost — can you prepare a short matrix of recommended models (open vs quantized) and expected median latencies for 8k context?
2) Data retention: for the evaluation we need confirmation that logs/inputs will be stored only in our S3 and that Redwood won’t persist user PII after the window.

If you can include those two items in the deck, it would speed alignment. Confirming 14 Dec 10:00 PT — please send the invite.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Product | Medsprint
maya@medsprint.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@medsprint.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + options to lock evaluation window

Perfect — I’ve penciled in Tue 14 Dec, 10:00–11:00 PT and will send a calendar invite in 10 minutes. Notes on your asks:

1) Model variants: Soojin will prepare a 1-slide matrix comparing 7B / 13B / q4 benchmarks and our recommended default for this workload based on expected latency and cost. Expect numbers for median latency at 512 / 2048 / 8192 tokens.

2) Data retention & security: short answer — for the Hosted evaluation we will route ingestion to your S3 and only surface logs per the MPA; Redwood will not persist PII beyond evaluation (we’ll document controls and the retention TTL). We’ll also attach the SOC 2 whitepaper and the short security checklist in the kickoff packet. Arjun can confirm specifics on the call.

I uploaded the mutual action plan draft to the doc (link below) and added initial owners. If you want edits before the call, feel free to change directly.

Calendar invite: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 10:00–11:00 PT
Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/rdw-eval-2109
MPA doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cMPA-proposed

See you Tues — Soojin and Marissa will cover the tech checklist and prompt benchmark approach.

Best,
Jordan
